title: OASIS
author: Misna Chanu
text:
I didn`t come here,
seeking for anything,
not even love.
But I came across
this land,
that`s so familiar
to my homeland!
Within you oh being!
I witness everything, –
that used to be mine!
Perhaps as a
realm of love!
And I bowed to your
soul, and that sight
became the oasis of
my soul!
This is another thing
that I am not
taking a single drop
of water from
this oasis!
All I am taking
with me is
the fragrance
of memory
of this sight,
I hope no land will
ever mind offering!
